about: The named regions of the real app captures in public/screens, measured on the captures themselves (capture px, 1080 x 2346), for the covers' "detail" (the loupe) and "phone" (the tag) compositions (src/cover/layout.mjs, design 2026-10-27). Each region: "box" [x, y, w, h] what is drawn, "key" [x, y, w, h] the short value or 2-3 words that prove the headline, "keyPx" the key text's font size in capture px (its digits' cap height / 0.69), "radius" the element's own corner radius when the box follows one (else 24 on the cover), "text" the key as it reads. COVER_ZOOM needs keyPx x z >= 96 on the cover, z = min(860 / w, 460 / h, 2.4) for detail and min(640 / w, 300 / h, 2.4) for a phone's tag: one value or a few words, a region of about 420 px or narrower for 17 pt app text. Add a region only after measuring it on the capture, and only on a capture verified against the current app (screens.json).
